Going head-to-head with Samsara and Lytx means coverage is everything, but most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit target. The gap shows up late, and by then the quarter is a scramble while reps burn time on research.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings FleetCam needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
